item.title: Crime Stoppers, AGLC and RCMP kick off anti-illicit tobacco campaign
item.description: Alberta Crime Stoppers hopes to hit organized crime where it hurts by launching a new anti-illicit tobacco campaign. Crime Stoppers held a news conference at 1:30 p.m. on Tuesday at the Alberta RCMP K Division headquarters to announce the new campaign, along with members of Alberta Gaming, Liquor and Cannabis (AGLC) and the RCMP community […]

item.title: Edmonton man charged with second-degree murder after dead body found on Highway 2
item.description: Slave Lake RCMP responded to a report of a dead body east of Slave Lake on Jan. 23. They treated the death as suspicious and later identified the body as 39-year-old Kirk Grey.

item.title: Thursday's letters: Attacking judges erodes rule of law
item.description: Politicians on both the left and right often wish they could find a way to “direct” judges to do their bidding. However, that is what happens in autocracies and dictatorships and not in a democratic country. A strong, independent judiciary is one of the pillars of the rule of law that needs to be cherished […]
